title: Logistics Throughput Is Not Resilient Access
summary: From aggregate movement through order fulfillment, custody, condition, affordability, essential access, alternatives and restoration.
map_question: What records are required before logistics throughput is not resilient access can support a bounded physical-economy decision?
interpretation_boundary: Installed capacity is not delivered reliable energy. Resource endowment is not qualified material supply. A factory announcement is not accepted production. Logistics throughput is not resilient access. Domestic-content percentage is not technological sovereignty. A decarbonization target is not a just industrial transition.

what_this_map_supports: Separate utility, material, manufacturing, logistics, reserve, sovereignty and transition decisions.
Explicit authority, identities, baselines, dependencies, distribution, alternatives, stress, review and remedy.
Public reasoning without asset, firm, supplier, worker, community, region, technology, jurisdiction or country scoring or ranking.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not allocate energy, water, materials, production, inventory, transport, reserves or emergency capacity.
It does not convert capacity, endowment, announcements, throughput, domestic content or targets into outcomes.
It does not create a receipt, score, rank, stage advance or operating-outcome change.
next_records_needed: A verified Phase 93 productive-development and transformation chain.
Separately adopted utility, material, manufacturing and supply-chain decisions.
Independent reliability, qualification, acceptance, access, resilience, transition, correction and propagation receipts.
